description: This file defines a report for generating an item-wise sales register in the ERPNext system. It includes functions for retrieving report data, calculating taxes, and constructing report columns based on filters and groupings. The core logic involves fetching sales invoice items, associated taxes, delivery notes, and other related details, then formatting and aggregating this data for report output.

methods.name: execute(filters=None)
methods.description: Main function that executes the report generation process, returning report columns and data.

methods.name: _execute(filters=None, additional_table_columns=None, additional_query_columns=None)
methods.description: Internal function that performs the main logic of fetching data, processing, and formatting for the report.

methods.name: get_columns(additional_table_columns, filters)
methods.description: Constructs the list of report columns based on filters and additional columns.

methods.name: get_conditions(filters)
methods.description: Builds SQL conditions based on provided filters.

methods.name: get_group_by_conditions(filters, doctype)
methods.description: Returns SQL ORDER BY clause based on the group_by filter.

methods.name: get_items(filters, additional_query_columns)
methods.description: Fetches sales invoice items along with associated invoice data based on filters.

methods.name: get_delivery_notes_against_sales_order(item_list)
methods.description: Maps delivery notes to sales orders for display.

methods.name: get_grand_total(filters, doctype)
methods.description: Calculates the grand total of sales for the report period.

methods.name: get_deducted_taxes()
methods.description: Returns list of tax entries marked as deducted taxes.

methods.name: get_tax_accounts(item_list, columns, company_currency, doctype='Sales Invoice', tax_doctype='Sales Taxes and Charges')
methods.description: Calculates and retrieves tax details for each invoice item, including item-wise taxes if available.

methods.name: add_total_row(data, filters, prev_group_by_value, item, total_row_map, group_by_field, subtotal_display_field, grand_total, tax_columns)
methods.description: Adds subtotal or total rows to the report data based on grouping.

methods.name: get_display_value(filters, group_by_field, item)
methods.description: Generates display string for grouped fields, with special formatting for item and party groups.

methods.name: get_group_by_and_display_fields(filters)
methods.description: Returns the appropriate group_by field and display field based on filters.

methods.name: add_sub_total_row(item, total_row_map, group_by_value, tax_columns)
methods.description: Accumulates data into subtotal rows for grouping.

ctags.name: add_total_row
ctags.signature: (data, filters, prev_group_by_value, item, total_row_map, group_by_field, subtotal_display_field, grand_total, tax_columns)

ctags.name: get_tax_accounts
ctags.signature: (item_list, columns, company_currency, doctype='Sales Invoice', tax_doctype='Sales Taxes and Charges')
